item.title: FREUNDORFER, Anna (née Pfutzner)
item.description: April 12, 1931 – February 18, 2026 It is with much sadness that we mourn the passing of our mother Anna Freundorfer at the age of 94 on the morning of Wednesday, February 18, 2026.

item.title: Dozens take the icy leap in Barrie police polar plunge as funds climb past $13,000
item.description: Angus resident Katleen Tremblay took home best costume honours from Deputy Chief Rob Burke after braving the icy water at the Barrie Police Polar Plunge — an event she said was personal because of her family’s connection to Down syndrome.

item.title: Partial U.S. government shutdown blamed for NEXUS closure at Canadian airports
item.description: Canadian airports are warning travellers that NEXUS and Global Entry pre-clearance programs for U.S.-bound flights are suspended, with Vancouver's airport linking the news with a partial U.S. government shutdown.

item.title: Bus crash near Napanee shuts eastbound section of Highway 401
item.description: NAPANEE — Provincial police in Ontario say a bus went off Highway 401 on Sunday evening, ending up on its side in the ditch. OPP Sgt. Erin Cranton says police were alerted about the crash, which happened east of Napanee, Ont., at around 7:15 p.m.
